onset.Description: Seconds from the start of this file. The file holds the 26 authors' epochs back to back (RecordingType = epoched, EpochLength = 1.3004 s); onsets are NOT times in the original continuous recording, which is not shared.

Levels.epoch: One authors' epoch (-0.4 to 0.9002 s around tone onset, 6502 samples)
Levels.tone: Tone onset (FieldTrip trialdef eventtype TRIGGER, eventvalue 4); time 0 of the epoch

value.Description: Trigger value defining the trials (4) for tone rows.

epoch.Description: Index of the epoch in the authors' FieldTrip data structure (1-based, data.trial order).

epoch_time_of_onset.Description: Time of this row relative to tone onset, from the authors' data.time axis.

trialinfo.Description: data.trialinfo value for this trial, as stored by the authors. Its meaning is not documented in the release (the protocol mentions an approximate button-press time of ~700 ms after the tone).

sampleinfo_begsample.Description: For epoch rows: data.sampleinfo begin sample (1-based) of the epoch in the original, unshared recording file. For tone rows: begin sample + 2000, i.e. the tone sample in the original recording.

sampleinfo_endsample.Description: data.sampleinfo end sample (1-based) of the epoch in the original, unshared recording file.
